preconditions: Search-path registry state (byte_8B5A3C records, dword_8B5A38 entry flags, count dword_8B8E30) is initialized before sub_53C800 registers strings; the registry is bounded at 32 entries of 132 bytes.
sub_53CBC0 requires a non-null, non-empty MAS filename a2; an empty or null input returns 0 without opening any file.

sub_4FC550 requires the season and track directory globals dword_5EC3D8 / dword_5EC420 (or the default directory byte_5EA438) to assemble the 'common\logomap.mas' path; the caller's `this` must be a cloud-scene object when flag a2 is nonzero.
sub_53C590 requires a non-null source pointer a2 and a destination buffer at byte_8B6AC8 large enough for the source string plus terminator; the raw C has no bounds guard.
sub_53CA00 requires the staging stack buffer (4224 bytes) to be safely probe-allocated (__alloca_probe) before the compaction loops run.
postconditions: sub_53C800 returns 0 when the input string is already registered; otherwise it shifts all existing entries up one 132-byte slot (via sub_53C6B0), writes the new string into slot 0 of byte_8B5A3C, increments dword_8B8E30, and returns the terminating index + 1.
sub_53C900 sets bit 0x400 on dword_8B5A38[33 * v4] for the matched entry and returns SearchPathPrune(this); an empty input returns the input pointer unchanged.
sub_53C9C0 rewrites every dword_8B5A38 entry that has bit 0x4000 set to (value & 0xFFFFBBFF) | 0x400 and returns SearchPathPrune(this).

sub_53CA00 compacts surviving entries (flag bit 0x400 clear) to the front of dword_8B5A38, zeroes the remaining slots from dword_8B5A38[33 * kept] up to the boundary dword_8B6AB8, and stores the surviving count into dword_8B8E30.

sub_53CBC0 on success appends the created cube-map object to the singly linked list rooted at dword_8B8F14 (next link at +0x130, back pointer at +0x12C), increments the object count dword_8B6AC0, writes the object pointer to *a1 when a1 is non-null, and returns 0; open/format failures report through sub_53C590 and return -1 or -2.

sub_4FC550 loads the common logomap.mas archive; when sub_53CBC0 returns 0 it optionally runs CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector (flag a2), registers cloud texture variants at this+0x50 and this+0x84 via sub_4FC400, and removes the loaded resource from the physics linked list.
side_effects: sub_4FC550 allocates a 256-byte path buffer, seeds/appends path components through cut-edge callees StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sub_5665B0, and frees the buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf on exit.
sub_53C800, sub_53C900, sub_53C9C0 and sub_53CA00 mutate the shared registry globals dword_8B8E30 / byte_8B5A3C / dword_8B5A38.
sub_53C590 copies the source string (including terminator) into the fixed global buffer byte_8B6AC8.
sub_53C6B0 writes a two-part structure into `this`: leading DWORD at +0x0 and null-terminated string at +0x4; with a null source it zeroes both.

sub_53CBC0 allocates a 308-byte object (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper), initializes it via sub_55FBE0, parses via sub_55FC40, opens/closes a file handle (12-byte header read), and links the object into the dword_8B8F14 list; on parse error -1/-2 it frees the object via EmptyStub_7470 / FreeWrapper_7bcf.
sub_53CBC0 formats '%s\\%s' path candidates and the 'Error opening MAS file %s' message into a 256-byte stack buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
sub_53C900 and sub_53CBC0 normalize input strings in a stack copy through the cut-edge helper sub_589901 before comparison or open.
